tagline.zh: 对元素『身后』的全部内容应用 filter 函数链:blur + saturate + brightness 三件套,是毛玻璃与各类系统玻璃材质的 Web 底座。
tagline.en: Applies a chain of filter functions to everything *behind* the element — blur + saturate + brightness, the web foundation under frosted glass and most system glass materials.

origin.zh: CSS Filter Effects Level 2 官方规范能力(调研 02 §4 D2);经典配方 blur(20px) 记载于 glassmorphism.com 生成器(调研 06 §四 §16),Apple 全局导航 blur(20px)+saturate(180%) 为生产 CSS 实测(superdesign.dev,同 styles/glassmorphism 条目)。
origin.en: An official CSS Filter Effects Level 2 capability (research 02 §4 D2); the classic blur(20px) recipe is recorded by the glassmorphism.com generator (research 06 §IV §16), and Apple's global-nav blur(20px)+saturate(180%) comes from production CSS measurements (superdesign.dev, same as the styles/glassmorphism entry).

effect.zh: 背景模糊半径,『磨砂厚度感』的直接来源。默认 20px = glassmorphism.com 生成器经典配方(调研 06 §四 §16);生产实测 Apple 全局导航同为 20px(superdesign.dev)。
effect.en: Backdrop blur radius — the direct source of the frosted 'thickness'. Default 20px is the glassmorphism.com generator's classic recipe (research 06 §IV §16); Apple's global nav measures the same 20px in production CSS (superdesign.dev).

effect.zh: 透出背景的饱和度补偿:磨砂会把背景色彩压淡,提高 saturate 找回鲜艳度。默认 180% = Apple 全局导航生产 CSS 实测值(blur(20px)+saturate(180%),superdesign.dev);100% 为恒等值,不改变色彩。
effect.en: Saturation compensation for the transmitted backdrop: frosting desaturates what shows through, so raising saturate restores vividness. Default 180% is the production-measured value on Apple's global nav (blur(20px)+saturate(180%), superdesign.dev); 100% is the identity no-op.

effect.zh: 透出背景的亮度调整。默认 100% 为 Filter Effects L1 定义的恒等点(调研 02 §4 D1);深色玻璃配方常用 <100% 压暗透出层,守住面板文字的对比度。
effect.en: Brightness adjustment on the transmitted backdrop. Default 100% is the identity point defined by Filter Effects L1 (research 02 §4 D1); dark-glass recipes go below 100% to dim what shows through and hold text contrast.

note.zh: backdrop-filter:Chrome 76 / Edge 17 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9(BCD 实测,调研 02 §4 D2);Safari 9–17 需 -webkit- 前缀,Safari 18(2024-09)起无前缀(调研 03 §1)。
note.en: backdrop-filter: Chrome 76 / Edge 17 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 (BCD-measured, research 02 §4 D2); Safari 9–17 requires the -webkit- prefix, unprefixed since Safari 18 (2024-09) (research 03 §1).

fallback.zh: @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) 时,提高面板填充不透明度(或改用实色表面)并保留描边与圆角,让文字回到可读底色上;Safari 9–17 必须同时写 -webkit-backdrop-filter。
fallback.en: Under @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)), raise the panel fill opacity (or switch to a solid surface) while keeping border and radius so text sits on a readable base; on Safari 9–17 also write -webkit-backdrop-filter.

use.zh: 悬浮导航与工具条——对照 Apple 全局导航 blur(20px)+saturate(180%) 生产实测
use.en: Floating nav bars and toolbars — cf. the production-measured Apple global nav blur(20px)+saturate(180%)

use.zh: 彩色照片/多层渐变上的浮层卡片与播放器
use.en: Overlay cards and players over colorful photos or gradients

use.zh: 模态/抽屉下面的层级垫层,让被遮内容保持可感知
use.en: Scrim layers under modals/drawers so covered content stays perceptible

use.zh: 图片上的字幕条与角标
use.en: Caption bars and badges on top of imagery

avoid.zh: 纯色/白色背景——背后没有可模糊的内容,玻璃直接失效
avoid.en: Flat or white backdrops — nothing to blur, the effect collapses

avoid.zh: 全屏大面积使用——背景每帧重采样,采样开销随面积上升
avoid.en: Full-screen slabs — the backdrop re-samples every frame, cost scales with area

avoid.zh: 小号正文与密集数据——填充稀释对比度且随背景滚动持续变化
avoid.en: Small body text and dense data — the fill dilutes contrast, which shifts as the backdrop scrolls

avoid.zh: 玻璃叠玻璃的多层嵌套——透出的层互相发浑
avoid.en: Glass stacked on glass — layered translucency turns muddy

a11y.zh: 面板上的文字按『透出背景最亮/最暗』两端核对 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3,调研 06 §五 §17);控件边界保持 3:1 非文本对比(SC 1.4.11);backdrop 内容滚动时对比度持续变化——偏实或偏暗的填充比高透填充更稳。
a11y.en: Check text on the panel against the brightest and darkest backdrop extremes for 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, research 06 §V §17); keep component boundaries at 3:1 non-text contrast (SC 1.4.11); backdrop scrolling shifts contrast continuously — firmer or darker fills hold up better than high-transparency ones.

goal.zh: 用 backdrop-filter 函数链 blur+saturate+brightness 做一块磨砂面板,悬浮于彩色照片与彩色大字标题之上,面板内容保持 4.5:1 可读。
goal.en: Build a frosted panel with a backdrop-filter chain of blur+saturate+brightness, floating over a colorful photo and oversized colorful type, with panel content kept readable at 4.5:1.

acceptance.zh: backdrop-filter 链式书写 blur(var) saturate(var) brightness(var),并同时写 -webkit- 前缀
acceptance.en: Write the backdrop-filter chain blur(var) saturate(var) brightness(var) with the -webkit- prefixed twin

acceptance.zh: 三个参数严格使用快照默认值:blur 20px / saturate 180% / brightness 100%
acceptance.en: Use the exact snapshot defaults: blur 20px / saturate 180% / brightness 100%

acceptance.zh: 背景必须是彩色照片+彩色大字——纯色底上磨砂面板只剩一层淡色矩形
acceptance.en: The backdrop must be a colorful photo plus colorful display type — on flat color the frost degenerates into a pale rectangle

acceptance.zh: 提供 @supports 回退:不支持时提高填充不透明度保证可读
acceptance.en: Provide an @supports fallback: raise fill opacity for readability when unsupported

acceptance.zh: 动效只落在 transform/opacity;prefers-reduced-motion 时取消入场动画
acceptance.en: Animate only transform/opacity; cancel entrance animation under prefers-reduced-motion
